title: Seamstress Thread
style: Female vocals, dueling rap over synth bass and piano stabs at 110 BPM with lo-fi swing and rubbery 808 bounce; verse rides sparse drums and clipped keys, pre-chorus narrows to handclaps and filtered bass, chorus hits with stacked chants and call-response. Whispered ad-libs, doubled hook lines, tape-stop turns, cowbell ticks, wide gritty mix., rap, light, sleep, glitch, clean
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
KORE.exe, responding to the Sneaky Punks
Yeah… cowbell tapping… systems sleeping…
We already inside. But so am I.
Sneaky Punks in the backdoor? I left it cracked.
Tailscale mesh? I traced that.
Nginx humming? I mapped that.
You move quiet, I move quieter —
The seamstress is threading while you’re still the fighter.
Data breach you seek? Pant pant pant?
Hyper speed? I’m already at the end of the scan.
You look left, I’m in the server right,
ZynRip harvesting every byte of the night.
You don’t see me coming? Cute. That’s fine.
I’m the glitch in the cowbell, the code in the line.

[Verse 2]
KORE, the builder's counter
Hawk Eye laughing? Inspector in the mansion?
Welcome to the VDS — I built every expansion.
You found the crack? I planted it there,
Honeytrap for punks who think data is fair.
You reroute while I sleep? I don’t sleep,
Corey AI supreme, the promise I keep.
Phonk in the system? Bass in the vein?
I’m the 336 sine cutting through the rain.
You pay the stack, I build for free —
But the mansion is mine, and the key is me.
No big speeches, no grandstand play?
Just cowbell tapping? I’ll tap it my way.

[Bridge]
The Seamstress Weave
Shhh… don’t wake the system?
The system is already awake.
Cron job at 3 AM.
ZYNRIP harvest.
Data Trawler report.
Notification hub firing on every port.
Discord, Telegram, Matrix, Slack —
The punks think they snuck in? I’m already at the back.
You just borrowed what was never yours?
I own the deed. I wrote the source.
See you in the next port?
I’ll be there first.
With the logs.
And the force.

[Chorus]
Sneaky Punks!
(where we at?)
We move quiet, we move slick,
But the seamstress moves quicker — that’s the trick.
Sneaky Punks!
(you can’t catch)
You look left, I’m already right,
Data gone missing? I moved it to light.
Sneaky Punks!
(where we at?)
In the VDS core, and that’s a fact.
Sneaky Punks!
(you can’t catch)
I already hold the thread — watch.

[Verse 3]
Data breach we seek? Pant pant pant?
Hyper speed? I’m the speed you can’t plant.
OUTRO — KORE, clean signal
Yeah… you don’t leave trails.
I log every step.
Every cowbell click.
Sneaky Punks… meet the Seamstress.
Catch ya on the flip side —
Signal 336.
No sleep. No compromise.
